fix_subject: Partitioned COPY: do not count rows of the next partition into a ROW_GROUP_SIZE_BYTES batch
pr_title: Fixes #26724, with the cause and the guard that kuza55 and 0xamlab

labels.summary: With ROW_GROUP_SIZE_BYTES, a partitioned COPY whose next partition starts exactly at the current row consumed one row of that partition and dropped the partition switch, so the second partition's rows were written into the first; the loop now checks its bounds before adding a row.
